hero.label: Mendix Consulting · Seoul
hero.headline: Low-code platforms don't transform enterprises. Capable teams do.
hero.subtext: We guide organisations and Mendix partners from adoption to genuine capability — whether that means upgrading a stalled Mx9 platform, building a CoE, or preparing your team for the AI features arriving this year.

problem.headline: Start is the easy part.
problem.body: Most Mendix teams build their first app and hit a wall they can't diagnose. Complexity creeps in, standards don't exist, and the next phase never arrives. The platform gets the blame. The real gap is knowing what to do after go-live.
problem.punchline: We know which phase you're in. And exactly how to move you forward.
problem.timing_body: Mendix 11 — the AI agentic LTS — is arriving later this year. The teams that will benefit are not the ones who wait. They are the ones building the right foundation today. Most are still on Mendix 9.

services.label: What we do
services.headline: From first sprint to full CoE. We cover the full Mendix lifecycle.
services.item1_desc: We start by understanding where you are. A structured review of your Mendix adoption, team capability, and platform usage — with a clear picture of what's blocking progress.
services.item2_desc: Still on Mendix 9? We start with an intake and scope determination — mapping your business rules, process logic, and custom work together with your team — then plan and execute a direct upgrade to Mx11, the AI-ready LTS. Skip the intermediate step. Get there once.
services.item3_desc: Hands-on Mendix development, sprint delivery, and technical guidance — whether you need us for a single phase or as a long-term extension of your team.
services.item4_desc: Governance, standards, architecture decisions, and application landscape management. We help you build the structure your Mendix practice needs to run well at scale.

process.label: How we work
process.headline: From where you are to where you need to be.
process.step1_desc: We start with a structured Mendix Maturity Assessment — platform usage, team capability, governance gaps. This becomes the baseline for everything that follows.
process.step2_title: We define where you need to be
process.step2_desc: A clear target — realistic, time-bound, and aligned with your business goals.
process.step3_desc: Hands-on delivery with your team. No black boxes. No dependency on us.
process.step4_desc: Some clients want a capable team that runs independently. Others want ongoing delivery support. We're flexible — the engagement ends when it makes sense, not before.

about.label: About us
about.headline: Dutch expertise. Seoul-based. Built for Asia.
about.body: We started as Mendix developers in the Netherlands and relocated to Seoul in 2022 to support Siemens DISW. Since then, we have guided organisations across the region through the technical and organisational side of digital transformation — bridging the European Mendix way of working with how APAC teams actually operate.
about.body2: A track record with enterprise clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Europe. English, Dutch, and remote-first.
about.body3: We also work directly with Mendix partners who need senior capacity on complex engagements. If you need backup, we are available.

contact.label: Get in touch
contact.headline: Ready to talk?
contact.subtext: Tell us where you are with Mendix and what's blocking you. We'll take it from there.

footer.tagline: Mendix expertise for the teams that need it.
